summary: Iteration 3 verification of TryLune's new/updated endpoints and Try-On + Room flows. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_analyze_and_room_edit.py with 11 pytest cases covering /api/analyze/body (auth, measurements-only -> M/Regular/93%/source=measurements, image-only -> lower confidence + estimated flags), /api/analyze/room (auth, 404, happy p7 returns room_dimensions_ft/clear_space_ft/furniture_dimensions_ft/fits/coverage_pct/verdict/notes), /api/visualize/room-edit (auth, 400 non-room p1, 404 unknown, happy p8 -> data:image/*;base64 payload with correct microcopy), and regression on /api/visualize/tryon-edit (p1). All 11/11 pass. Frontend Playwright E2E: login as admin, TryOn(/try-on?product=p1) -> choose-file-btn upload -> size-analysis card visible -> analyze-body-btn -> size-result shows M/Regular/82% -> visualize-btn -> processing-overlay -> tryon-result with BeforeAfter (data-testid=before-after). Room(/room?product=p7) -> upload -> visualize-btn -> processing-overlay -> room-result with BeforeAfter AND room-analysis card showing room=14x12 ft, furn=6.9x2.9 ft, fit-badge='Fits', verdict='Fits comfortably in the available space.'. Demo-fail path works for both TryOn and Room: validation-panel BLOCKED, processing-overlay absent, no edit endpoint call. Navbar/logo/login title show 'TryLune'.

minor.issue: Occasional 502 from Gemini (no image returned) — backend has no automatic retry; single hiccup surfaces directly to user. Same issue flagged in iteration 2 for tryon-edit.

ui_bugs.issue: Branding leak — page still reads 'New to VirtueNova?' next to the 'Create an account' link. Rebrand requires this to say 'New to TryLune?'.

action_items: Rebrand Login.jsx line 144: replace 'New to VirtueNova?' with 'New to TryLune?' (the toggle-auth-mode link is fine).

(Optional resilience) Add a single automatic retry inside /api/visualize/tryon-edit and /api/visualize/room-edit when the Gemini call returns an empty images list, to eliminate the occasional user-visible 502.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 898 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, catalog, visualize, analyze, cart/wishlist) before adding more endpoints.

/api/visualize/room-edit and /api/visualize/tryon-edit both perform blocking network I/O via requests.get inside async endpoints when fetching the product image (via _fetch_image_b64 / requests.get). Prefer httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.
No caching of product source images — each edit re-downloads the CDN image. In-memory cache keyed by product_id would materially speed up switch-garment / switch-piece re-runs and reduce cost.
Neither edit endpoint has retry logic when Gemini returns zero images; a single transient refusal surfaces as a 502 to the user.

RoomViz.jsx runs /analyze/room and /visualize/room-edit in parallel via Promise.allSettled — good; but if only analyze fails silently (rejected), the UI shows no error/notes to the user (analysis stays null). Consider a subtle toast when analysis fails but the edit succeeds.

/api/analyze/room always returns estimated: true regardless of whether the Gemini vision call actually succeeded — the fallback branch sets rw,rl,cw,cd to hardcoded 12/14/7/6 with a generic note but still marks estimated=true; consider adding source='vision'|'fallback' so the UI can distinguish and warn the user.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (TryOn happy + demo-fail, Room happy + demo-fail, login, navbar branding)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded products p1 (Fashion) and p7/p8 (Furniture) and admin user. Synthetic person/room JPEGs generated in /tmp/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four new/updated endpoints are verified: /api/analyze/body (auth-guarded, measurements=>M/Regular/93 conf, image-only=>lower conf w/ estimated=true), /api/analyze/room (auth, 404 unknown, ok on p7 returning room/clear/furniture dims + fits + coverage_pct + verdict), /api/visualize/room-edit (auth, 400 non-room, 404 unknown, ok on p8 returning data:image base64 + microcopy 'AI photo edit — furniture placed in your actual room'), and /api/visualize/tryon-edit still ok on p1. Frontend selectors used: choose-file-btn (or the hidden input[type=file]), garment-p1, furniture-p7, demo-fail-toggle input[type=checkbox], visualize-btn, processing-overlay, tryon-result, room-result, before-after, size-analysis, analyze-body-btn, size-result, recommended-size/-fit/confidence, room-analysis, room-dims, furniture-dims, fit-badge, room-verdict, validation-panel. Real edits take ~8-40s; poll up to 120s. One residual UI branding bug: Login.jsx still says 'New to VirtueNova?' — main agent should change it to 'New to TryLune?'.
rca of the issue: Login.jsx line 144 hard-codes the string 'New to VirtueNova?' — the earlier rebrand pass updated the logo/navbar/title but missed this label. Fix: change 'New to VirtueNova?' to 'New to TryLune?'.
